fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-10-10 states that the complainant received an SMS with a link resembling a bank notification; after entering card details on the page, Rs. 45,000 was debited, on 2025-10-03 at roughly 09:20. Ganesh Subramani submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000240. The account reference SYN-ACC-100032 was noted in connection with the payment. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. A person named Mathan Velan, associated with the number 9000000147, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned digital documents and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, receiving account, apartment complex, morning, suspect, mobile number, phone records
